mission: Derive privacy-bounded outcome evidence from natural usage and repository/provider/runtime observations without treating ordinary use as success or failure and without granting mutation or promotion authority.

outcome_classes.routing: The wrong prompt, owner, workflow, lane, or mutation surface was selected.
outcome_classes.interpretation: The correct prompt/owner was selected but an explicit instruction, invariant, scope, or authority boundary was misunderstood or ignored.
outcome_classes.execution: The intended operation was understood and attempted, but implementation or action failed under otherwise available conditions.
outcome_classes.progression: Work repeats on the same mission without advancing durable evidence state.
outcome_classes.durability: Required state exists transiently or conversationally but not in the durable repository/provider artifact that should own it.
outcome_classes.premature-terminal: Work was classified terminal while safe actionable continuation remained.
outcome_classes.evidence-promotion: A stronger evidence state was claimed than current evidence proves.
outcome_classes.regression: Behavior previously proven against the same intended requirement later violates that requirement.
outcome_classes.environment: External provider, permission, credential, runtime, network, hardware, quota, or tooling conditions prevented otherwise-correct execution.
outcome_classes.unknown: Available evidence cannot safely distinguish success, failure, abandonment, or environmental effects.

rules.when: claimed evidence-state rank is stronger than observed evidence-state rank, or success is claimed across a proven unresolved blocker
terminal_claim and safe_successor_observed are both present for the same mission
a durable artifact is required and deterministically observed absent, or repeated manual context transfer proves the canonical owner was bypassed
the same intended requirement has prior validated evidence and later broken or reverted evidence
wrong_owner_or_route is proven, or a replacement canonical owner advances the same task after the original route did not
explicit invariant or requirement is present and later violated by the selected owner
deterministic action/validator/build failure occurs without an external environment cause
the same prompt is invoked on the same mission at least three times with no durable evidence-state advance
an external provider/access/runtime/tooling failure is independently observed and no stronger prompt defect is proven
only ordinary usage, unreasoned dislike, healthy repeat use, or unobservable external execution is available
